set.pack.hint: Pick the B folder, not the xiaoke-content.json inside it. Browse again if you picked the wrong one. Save, then close the window and open it again.
set.pack.restart: Close the window and open it again before the new folder is used.
set.pack.reopen: Saved. Close the window and open it again.
set.gate.lead: Pick the B folder (for example xiaoke-ai-B). Do not click xiaoke-content.json. That file is only a marker. The folder is enough.
set.gate.note: Close the window and open it again after saving. Updating the app (A) does not require touching B.
set.mod.off: Off means it is not installed. Chat, the stage, and the interface stop using it. A low-end machine turns memory off so the vector store does not stall the process.
set.mod.memory: Long-term facts stay in local SQLite. The vectors are only an index. Changing the embedding rebuilds the collection. The sentences stay.
set.mod.embedHint: Uses the same key as recognition and speech, the one in AI chat. Volcano calls Ark doubao-embedding. Aliyun calls Bailian text-embedding. OpenAI calls text-embedding-3-small. Gemini calls gemini-embedding-001. ElevenLabs has no embeddings. If it does not match, it falls back to local MiniLM. Changing this saves at once and rebuilds the index in the background.
set.mod.scenes: She is already in the scene when you arrive, and later lines stay there. Random, picked, or made up. Background, camera, and mood follow.
set.mod.rewrite: Say the last line another way, rewind and continue, or play the same line again in another mood. That replay does not call the model.
set.mod.keepsake: Capture tonight from the stage. With memory on, saving a keepsake also writes a fact. The switch takes effect at once.
set.mod.tarot: She sits across from you and draws. Say “draw a card”, or tap Cards in the chat bar. For fun, not advice. Off means it is not installed.
set.mod.tavern: Four seats. Before you sit, pick a deck and an art style. One deck is Lolita, Maiden, and Lady. The other is Puppy, Boyish, and Daddy. Charm is the high joker, Shade the low one, and both are wild. Tap the mark in the chat bar to sit. Off means it is not installed.
set.mod.code: Open Code companion in the chat bar. It watches Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Lingma, Trae, and Comate. She speaks when you start and when you stop. While you work, only the badge stays lit. Off means it is not installed.
set.mod.touch: A tap on her head, face, chest, waist, or hand gets a different reaction: a squint, a shy dodge, covering up, or nothing. The same spot grows dull, numb, then cold. She only sometimes speaks, and that still uses her normal voice. No reaction while dancing, motion-captured, or reading cards. Off means it is not installed.
set.mod.harness: When on, ordinary talk goes through the built-in dsh, with chat as one of its skills. Cards, rewrites, welcomes, and silence follow-ups stay on the existing chat path. Turning it off stops that process.
set.mod.glance: Off by default. The eye button on the top bar or beside the desktop pet, or saying “watch with me” or “turn vision on”, starts company and the local vision process. Press again, or say “stop watching” or “turn vision off”, and that process exits. Closing the app exits it too.
set.mod.glanceLabHint: Opens the local watch log in the browser. It no longer opens when the service starts.
set.mod.liveDouyin: Off by default. Paste a room and connect. A browser window opens and reads that room's comments, gifts, and likes. They stay here and do not interrupt her. Close the window or disconnect to stop. Mini-game callback: /api/modules/live/douyin/callback. A push secret turns signature checks on.
live.douyin.secretPh: Leave empty to skip the check
set.vision.label: Vision model for watching along
set.vision.keyPh: API key for this vision model
set.vision.hint: Capture stays in the eyes process. Local MiniCPM looks there. Any other model only receives the frames, the same way chat calls an LLM. Pixels never enter the conversation. Save after changing this.
set.llm.label: Provider (fills the address and a suggested model)
set.llm.ph: Pick a provider, or type the fields below
set.llm.endpoint: A Doubao character model name cannot enter the skill catalog. Put an endpoint id that starts with ep-, or another model name, in that field.
set.llm.harnessPh: ep-… or another model; blank follows the chat model
set.llm.harnessUrlPh: Blank uses the chat URL above
set.llm.harnessHint: Chat uses the model above. The skill catalog uses this one. Test connection checks both. Welcomes and silence follow-ups stay on the chat model.
set.llm.env: No key in settings. Using the environment or a local .env. The secret is not written to the database.
set.llm.hint: These providers speak the OpenAI-compatible API. Picking one fills the address and a suggested model; the key still has to be that provider's own. Local Ollama, vLLM, and SGLang get the placeholder key ollama when the field is empty. Azure and Cloudflare addresses contain your resource or account, so paste those yourself. Test the connection, then save.
set.llm.thinkHint: Thinking reasons first, then answers. Smarter, but the first sentence is slower. Some models cannot switch (Bailian kimi-k3 can only think). If it errors, go back to Follow the model default.
set.llm.max: Max reply length in tokens (0 = the provider default)
set.llm.nokey: It works without a key. Chat uses the local fallback. Voice, lips, and dance still run.
set.omni.hint: MiniCPM-o 4.5 sees, hears, and speaks in one model. This process cannot load its 9B weights (they clash with the local Qwen TTS transformers build, and they want about 22GB of VRAM). The test uses the official cloud: text through Chat Completions, voice through Realtime. Point Realtime at your own gateway if you run one.
set.omni.keyPh: Empty uses the chat ModelBest key, or COMPANION_OMNI_API_KEY
set.omni.env: No key here. Using COMPANION_OMNI_API_KEY / MODELBEST_API_KEY.
set.omni.sample: Introduce yourself in two short spoken sentences.
set.asr.title: Speech recognition
set.asr.hint: Aliyun, Volcano, OpenAI, Gemini, ElevenLabs, and the offline engine all wait for the browser to hear you, then send that clip. Browser Web Speech only works in Chrome or Edge.
set.asr.cloud: Recognition, speech, and memory embeddings share the key in AI chat. Aliyun uses one Bailian sk- key (qwen3-asr-flash, CosyVoice, text-embedding). Volcano uses the Ark key (Doubao ASR 2.0, seed-tts-2.0, doubao-embedding). If Volcano speech rejects the key, the voice console key differs from Ark: set VOLC_SPEECH_API_KEY.
set.asr.ali: Online · Aliyun Bailian (same sk- as chat)
set.asr.volc: Online · Volcano Doubao ASR 2.0 (same key as chat)
set.asr.gemini: Online · Google Gemini (same key as chat)
set.asr.cloudIntl: OpenAI and Gemini share the AI chat key for recognition, speech, and embeddings. The chat base URL must be api.openai.com or generativelanguage.googleapis.com. You can also set OPENAI_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY. ElevenLabs has no chat or embeddings: set ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, and recognition and speech share that key.
set.tts.title: Speech synthesis
set.tts.volcEngine: Online · Volcano Doubao TTS 2.0 (same key as chat)
set.tts.openaiEngine: Online · OpenAI speech (same key as chat)
set.tts.geminiEngine: Online · Google Gemini speech (same key as chat)
set.tts.cosyEngine: Online · Aliyun CosyVoice (same sk- as chat)
set.tts.sizeLead: 0.6B is faster and lighter. 1.7B sounds better. Both share the nine voices below. Switching unloads the current model and loads the other.
set.tts.stylePh: For example: low, a little breathy, unhurried.
set.tts.styleHint: Tone applies only on 1.7B. 0.6B ignores it. For 清宵: 1.7B, Serena, and the cool tone. Changing tone does not reload the model. The next line uses it after you save.
set.tts.voicePh: Pick a voice for this engine
set.tts.voiceHint: Changing the speech language picks that language's default voice. Chinese and English both use Serena, so English stays a woman's voice. Japanese is Ono Anna, Korean is Sohee. A voice you already chose for that language is remembered. Changing only the interface leaves the voice alone. Qwen runs on the local GPU.
set.tavern.castHint: Blank assigns automatically. XiaO is female, AI is male. KE is male on the Lolita deck and female on the other deck. The referee uses the character's voice. Local voices go first, then Edge.
set.tts.duplex: When she is still talking, how the next turn joins
set.tts.remain: Interrupt only if more than {n}s of audio is left
set.tts.delayed: Continue after a pause (about {n}s, 0 off; it jitters)
set.tts.proactive: Speak up on her own (about {n}s, 0 off; it jitters)
set.tts.goodbye: Say goodbye after you stay quiet (about {n}s, 0 off; it jitters)
set.tts.session: Goodbye when the session reaches this many minutes (0 off; it jitters)
set.tts.ingress: While she dances or talks, praise waits. Only a real request interrupts.
set.tts.duplexHint: One reply is split into whole sentences, A1, A2, A3, and played in order. They do not interrupt each other. If you ask again while she is still playing: a long remainder switches to the new answer, a short one finishes the current sentence first. Unspoken leftovers from the old turn are dropped. With the split on, “that dance was good” does not stop a dance, and “another one” does. While she talks, a small “mm” is held and a question starts a new turn. Speech waits until there are words, so a noise does not cut the performance. When you are both quiet she continues after a while (about 10–28 seconds, never stuck on an even 6), then speaks up (about half a minute to a bit over one), then says goodbye by how long you have been quiet (about 1.5–3.5 minutes). Each time lands somewhere in that range, the way a person hesitates. When the session time is up she says goodbye and stays quiet until you speak.
set.tts.cosy: CosyVoice voices are the Longan set. The key is the Bailian sk- in AI chat, shared with recognition and embeddings.
set.tts.volc: Voices are Doubao TTS 2.0 (Vivi, Xiaohe). The key is the one in AI chat. If auth fails, set VOLC_SPEECH_API_KEY to the Doubao Voice console key.
set.tts.openai: The official 13 voices on gpt-4o-mini-tts. Default is Marin. Recognition uses gpt-transcribe and embeddings use text-embedding-3-small, on the same chat key.
set.tts.eleven: Official premade voices (Rachel, Adam, Aria, and others) on Flash v2.5, multilingual. Recognition uses Scribe v2. Set ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. ElevenLabs has no embeddings. Premade voices retire after 2026-12-31.
set.tts.gemini: The official 30 premade voices (Kore, Zephyr, Puck, and others) on gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts. Recognition listens with Gemini, embeddings use gemini-embedding-001, on the same chat key.
set.duplex.interrupt_or_queue: Next turn: interrupt only if more than N seconds remain
set.duplex.queue: Next turn: wait until she finishes
set.duplex.conditional_queue: Next turn: queue only if less than N seconds remain, otherwise drop
set.duplex.conditional_interrupt: Next turn: interrupt only if more than N seconds remain, otherwise drop
set.embed.auto: Auto (Doubao on Volcano, Qwen on Bailian, OpenAI and Gemini on their own models, otherwise local)
set.hw.auto: The engine was chosen from this machine so it can start
set.hw.manual: Using what you saved. It will not change itself.
set.dl.token: aplaybox login token (some works download only after a like or save, which needs a login)
set.dl.ph: After you log in, copy token from a request header in the devtools
set.dl.hint: How to get it: log in at aplaybox.com, open devtools with F12, Network, any api.aplaybox.com request, the token header. Meeting a download rule will like, save, or follow with your account.
set.q.physics: Physics (hair and skirt; turn off on a low-end machine)
set.q.physicsHint: PMX models only. The switch takes effect at once and is remembered.
set.q.light: Light (nudge if the model is too bright or dark; 1.0 is standard)
set.q.sceneOn: With Scenes on, the background follows tonight's scene. Clicking here switches to that scene instead of saving a separate picture.
set.q.tooBig: That picture is over 8MB. Pick another.
set.q.tex: Stage texture (scenes set one; you can change it)
set.q.opacity: Stage opacity (lower lets the background through)
set.q.hint: A choice takes effect at once. Save at the bottom to keep it. Picture scenes turn off the depth fog and keep the round stage.
set.look.customSet: The picture you just picked is the place.
set.embed.switched: Embedding changed. Rebuilding the index in the background. The facts stay.
